name: A4F
short: Unified AI proxy and gateway providing access to hundreds of LLMs through an OpenAI-compatible API key with a free tier.

plans.name: Free Tier
plans.notes: Instant OpenAI-compatible API key upon sign-up (no credit card required to begin — verbatim on homepage). Free plan: Limited AI Models, 5 RPM rate limit, 300 RPD request limit. Free forever.

plans.name: Pro / Credit Pack
plans.notes: Higher request concurrency, priority routing, failovers, and expanded access to premium frontier model pipelines. Introductory price $40/month; increases to $45/month (announcement 2025-11-20). Yearly $336/year.
